description: Check whether a claimed quote or fact actually appears on a URL — a cheap citation/hallucination checker. Returns verdict exact_match, close_match (with a confidence score and the closest matching passage), or not_found. Paid: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base via x402 — call once without x_payment to receive the payment challenge.

claim.description: The quote or fact to verify appears on the page (max 2000 chars)

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope the search to

url.description: Public http/https URL to check the claim against

x_payment.description: Optional X-PAYMENT header value from a completed x402 payment. Omit on first call to receive the payment challenge; complete the payment with your x402 wallet tooling, then retry with this set.

name: verify_claim
